h: The Truth of Divine Salvation Brings Lasting Healing

p: "And as for me, my prayer, etc. (Tehillim 69:14),
answer me with the truth of Your salvation."
בַּזּוֹהַר חָדָשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ נד, עַמּוּד ג)
רְפָאֵנִי ה׳ וְאֵרָפֵא וְגוֹ׳ (יִרְמְיָה יז, יד)
"'Heal me, Hashem, and I will be healed, etc.' (Yirmiyahu 17:14)
what is 'and I will be healed'?
what is 'and I will be saved'? etc.
Rather, all the cures in the world
are in the hand of the Holy One, blessed be He;
but there are some of them
and there are some of them
that were not handed over to a messenger;
and those handed over to a messenger
אֲבָל אִינּוּן דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא מַסֵּי
but those that the Holy One, blessed be He, heals
that illness does not return, etc."
"heal me and I will be healed":
that some come through a messenger,
for the doctor was given permission to heal
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּרָכוֹת ס, סוֹף עַמּוּד א)
"save me and I will be saved"
it did not answer at all;
for is there not no savior
Yirmiyahu the prophet did not speak
of the healing of the body,
but of the healing of the soul;
for his words concerned Klal Yisrael,
asking for healing from the sins
on account of which was decreed
the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash
and this is for the past.
And likewise salvation from the yetzer hara
הוּא גַּם כֵּן עַל יְדֵי דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
is also through words of Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א רב, א)
But there are cases where the healing comes
that come through one who rebukes,
who puts words of Torah into the heart
for which healing does not avail
רַק כְּשֶׁהוּא עַל יְדֵי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
but only when it is through Hashem Yisbarach.
And although the main words of Torah that rectify
and it comes through a teacher
yet when the words of Torah shine in the heart
the very essence of the Name Havayah,
כִּי אֵשֵׁב בַּחוֹשֶׁךְ ה׳ אוֹר לִי
"though I sit in darkness, Hashem is a light to me,"
also the afflictions of the body,
שֶׁבָּאִין גַּם כֵּן עַל יְדֵי חֵטְא
for "there are no afflictions without sin,"
he has for the afflictions of the body
and this is what is said,
"Heal me, Havayah, and I will be healed."
גַּם כֵּן יֵשׁ עַל יְדֵי דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
there also is through words of Torah
that one learns from a teacher,
and this is called salvation through a messenger;
for it is no better than Matan Torah,
meaning they would not have died
and they were free from the Angel of Death,
for then the yetzer hara was uprooted from their hearts
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה א)
the yetzer hara returned to its place.
and knew nothing at all of evil
This is not so when the salvation
through which the Name Havayah shines in the heart;
then it is an everlasting salvation.
And this is what is said,
"Heal me, Havayah, and I will be healed;
save me and I will be saved":
and likewise the salvation for the future
and then the salvation will be everlasting.
when one merits the supernal Shabbos,
"and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there"
(as it says in Tikkunei Zohar, Tikkun 48)
in the Minchah prayer of Shabbos,
"answer me with the truth of Your salvation";
וּשְׂפַת אֱמֶת תִּכּוֹן לָעַד (מִשְׁלֵי יב, יט)
and "the lip of truth shall be established forever" (Mishlei 12:19):
that it be an everlasting salvation,
so that the yetzer hara never return.
